use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE

fivenum(xs_raw: double[]) -> double[] is
    let xs = xs_raw |> sort() |> collect_array()
    let n = xs.count
    let n4 = System.Math.floor((cast double(n) + 3.0) / 2.0) / 2.0
    let d = [
        1.0, n4, (cast double(n) + 1.0) / 2.0,
        cast double(n) + 1.0 - n4, cast double(n)
    ]
    midpoint(di: double) -> double is
        let lo = xs[cast int(System.Math.floor(di)) - 1]
        let hi = xs[cast int(System.Math.ceiling(di)) - 1]

        0.5 * (lo + hi)
    si

    d |> map(midpoint) |> collect_array()
si

let datasets = [
    (label = "first set",
     values = [
        15.0, 6.0, 42.0, 41.0, 7.0, 36.0, 49.0, 40.0, 39.0, 47.0, 43.0
     ]),
    (label = "second set",
     values = [36.0, 40.0, 7.0, 39.0, 41.0, 15.0])
]

let half = 0.16

let dark = (red = 45ub, green = 75ub, blue = 130ub)
let pale = (red = 160ub, green = 185ub, blue = 225ub)
let median_colour = (red = 195ub, green = 70ub, blue = 45ub)

box(image: IMAGE, summary: double[], centre: double) is
    image.colour(dark)
    image.stroke(1.4)
    image.line(summary[0], centre, summary[4], centre)
    image.line(summary[0], centre - half, summary[0], centre + half)
    image.line(summary[4], centre - half, summary[4], centre + half)

    image.colour(pale)
    image.fill_rectangle(
        summary[1], centre - half, summary[3], centre + half)

    image.colour(dark)
    image.line(
        [(x = summary[1], y = centre - half),
         (x = summary[3], y = centre - half),
         (x = summary[3], y = centre + half),
         (x = summary[1], y = centre + half),
         (x = summary[1], y = centre - half)])

    image.colour(median_colour)
    image.stroke(2.2)
    image.line(summary[2], centre - half, summary[2], centre + half)
si

annotate(image: IMAGE, summary: double[], centre: double) is
    image.colour(80ub, 85ub, 100ub)

    for at in [0, 2, 4] do
        image.text(
            summary[at], centre - half - 0.155, 12.0,
            "{summary[at]}", Anchor.CENTRE)
    od

    for at in [1, 3] do
        image.text(
            summary[at], centre + half + 0.055, 12.0,
            "{summary[at]}", Anchor.CENTRE)
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(740, 320)

image.colour(95ub, 100ub, 115ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.x_title = "value"
axes.y_ticks(
    datasets
        |> index()
        |> map(set =>
            (value = cast double(datasets.count - set.index) - 0.5,
             label = set.value.label))
        |> collect_list())

axes.fit(0.0, 0.0, 55.0, cast double(datasets.count))
axes.draw()

for set in datasets |> index() do
    let centre = cast double(datasets.count - set.index) - 0.5

    box(image, fivenum(set.value.values), centre)
    annotate(image, fivenum(set.value.values), centre)
od

image.write("fivenum.png")

image.show("fivenum.png")
